title: Review finding
description: One finding from one reviewer seat. scripts/aggregate-findings.py enforces this shape and does not need a schema library. The family is derived from the model name by the runner, never typed by the reviewer.

harness.description: Harness that ran the reviewer seat.

family.description: Model family of the rung that answered.

path.description: Path of the artifact the finding points at, relative to the review root.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: The quote, command output or reference that shows it.

fix.description: Optional smallest change that would remove the problem.
